newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee strengthens against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee strengthens against the dollar.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee strengthened slightly against the dollar but weakened against the pound on Wednesday in line with international trends, foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee was fixed at a mean commercial rate of 20.0035 against the dollar from 20.0230 on Tuesday. The rupee traded at a mean of 32.7075 against the pound from 32.6975 on Tuesday.
Dealers said the rupee's fixing on Wednesday reflected a weaker dollar in overnight international markets.
